rejected.rationale: Documentation drift only (no runtime behaviour, no AC covers docs/api). Response.java and docs/api/* are outside the lane write set and the review range; the relay API itself predates this diff. Not a block condition. Hand the relay/defaultCache-exception text to the docs step (CLAUDE.md requires docs/api to follow API changes).

Execution probe shows IAE with the stream closed once; FR-HTTP-037 AC-4 and AC-8 each hold in their own condition and do not order the overlap. Argument-first validation matches the existing res.stream convention (null contentType -> NPE before state check). Stream ownership honoured.
Test-quality observation, not a defect: the green path never depends on the 50 ms pause, and the decisive check is deterministic for a synchronous eager copy. Cannot flake toward failure.
FR-ENGINE-014 AC-6 only requires the connection to close before 5 body bytes arrive; the assertion pins that. A stricter head assertion is optional hardening, not a missed AC.
Absence assertions need a bounded window; abort fires before closeInput in runTransfer so the latch orders the normal case. No failing execution evidence.
205 handling is pre-existing bodyless() behaviour shared by send/stream, not introduced by this diff and not covered by FR-HTTP-036/037/FR-ENGINE-014. Would need a separate cross-writer requirement.
Unproven race: suite green, t.send returns after completion, no execution evidence of cross-thread runTransfer in the in-memory adapter. Test-only hygiene.

clean_code.reason: Valid temporal coupling: the relayed field is written in startBody only to be read by begin a line later and then lingers as instance state. All four begin callers (lines 174, 686, 1066x2) are in DefaultResponse.java, inside the lane write set; no public API change.
clean_code.fix_hint: Remove the relayed field. Add a parameter begin(long length, byte[] body, boolean applyDefaultCache) (or a private overload with the 2-arg form delegating with true); startBody passes !relay, the other callers keep applying defaultCache. Keep the FR-HTTP-036 AC-6 comment on the Cache-Control fill.

clean_code.reason: The boolean names one concept, relay semantics (FR-HTTP-036/037: 304 Content-Length retention and the defaultCache bypass are both parts of the relay contract), on a private method whose javadoc documents it. Splitting it into an enum or two flags adds indirection for three private call sites; after CC-001 the same flag becomes the single carrier into begin, which is the clearer shape. Not a real single-responsibility violation.

Conflicts with existing convention: per-class private case-insensitive header scans already exist in SseStreamTest:27, DefaultResponseTest:42, RequestRawHeadersTest:207/249 and ErrorPathTest:631. A shared helper would belong in the shared testing package (e.g. ClientResponse/TestApp utilities), which is outside the lane write set and a shared test utility.

RawTargetSocketTest.Http is a nested class of another test file; reusing or extending it means editing RawTargetSocketTest.java, outside the lane write set, and turning it into a shared test utility.
